profile.headline: Top Secret / SCI | Software Engineer | Microsoft Leap
profile.summary:
Hello, I'm Chris, an aspiring software developer currently enrolled in the Microsoft Software Systems Academy as I make my transition out of the Air Force. I am excited to dive head first into the tech world and take on all of the challenges it throws my way.

Background:
While in the Air Force I took on many roles, initially as a student where I endured a nearly two year program learning and becoming fluent in Arabic. Once I finished my training I put it to use as a cryptologic language analyst supporting missions across the Middle East. While I was in this position I found an interest in the technological aspect of the work and constantly pushed myself to learn new things that were outside of my scope. Now, I am excited to fully devote myself to the tech industry as I start a new chapter in my life.

My Future: 
I aspire to work and master my craft and using that experience to drive innovation and excellence in my field. I thrive in environments that value progression and development as well as creating an environment that establishes equality and diversity for everyone in that environment. I look forward to working on a team that is always looking for ways to improve and better themselves and the products they deliver.

positions.title: Cloud Application Development Learner
positions.description:
- Attending Cloud Application Development program as one of 10 students from 112-applicant pool
- Studying C#, ASP.NET, Microsoft Azure, SQL, and JavaScript/HTML5/CSS3

positions.title: Target Analysis Reporter Team Lead
positions.locationName: Fort George G. Meade, Maryland, United States
positions.description:
Led a three-member team focused on improving the unit’s level of reporting across multiple platforms for multiple agencies. Worked as the final eyes on products released by the unit, performing quality check processes, reviewed content, and ultimately published those products to different departments.

-	Led an instructor team in developing and implementing the unit’s first course designed to strengthen reporting capabilities, improving the unit’s products and reputation across the DoD.

-	Taught multiple three-week courses to members increasing unit capabilities by 40% over 6 months.

-	Quality checked products, corrected mistakes, and ensured reporting standards were upheld before their release.

positions.title: Cryptologic Linguist
positions.description:
Used foreign language skills to search for, monitor, identify, and process communications involving activities of interest. Analyzed and reported intelligence information consumed by customers within the Air Force, Intelligence Community, DoD, U.S. government, and foreign partners.

- Chosen to be the “Subject Matter Expert” (SME) for office mission, worked as the lead analyst and led a team of 25 members on shift.

- Briefed upper management weekly with presentations on information that required timely decisions

- Led training and qualification program that trained over 20 members, created how-to guides, tutorials for relevant tools, modernized training requirements which lead to an increase in available manning during the pandemic.
